  /* Khu vực chơi: chiếm hết phần còn lại của màn hình */
  #stage {
    flex: 1 1 auto;
    min-height: 0;

    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
  }

  #game {
    display: grid;
    gap: 12px;
    cursor: none; /* chỉ ẩn con trỏ trong khu vực lỗ */
  }

  .hole {
    width: var(--size);
    height: var(--size);
    background: #5a3921;
    border-radius: 50%;
    position: relative;
    overflow: hidden;
    cursor: none;
    box-shadow: inset 0 5px 10px rgba(0,0,0,0.3);
  }

  .mole {
    width: 70%;
    height: 70%;
    position: absolute;
    bottom: -100%;
    left: 15%;
    transition: bottom 0.15s ease-out;
  }

  .mole svg {
    width: 100%;
    height: 100%;
    display: block;
  }

  .hole.up .mole {
    bottom: 15%;
  }

  /* Lỗ bị đập: rung mạnh */
  .hole.hit {
    animation: holeHit 0.25s ease-out;
  }

  @keyframes holeHit {
    0%   { transform: scale(0.82); }
    35%  { transform: scale(0.88) translateX(-4px); }
    65%  { transform: scale(0.95) translateX(4px); }
    100% { transform: scale(1); }
  }

  /* Rung cả màn hình khi đập trúng */
  #stage.shake {
    animation: shake 0.3s linear;
  }

  @keyframes shake {
    0%   { transform: translate(0, 0); }
    15%  { transform: translate(-9px, 6px); }
    30%  { transform: translate(8px, -7px); }
    45%  { transform: translate(-6px, -4px); }
    60%  { transform: translate(5px, 5px); }
    80%  { transform: translate(-2px, 2px); }
    100% { transform: translate(0, 0); }
  }

  /* Khói */
  #fx {
    position: fixed;
    inset: 0;
    pointer-events: none;
    z-index: 9000;
    overflow: hidden;
  }

  .smoke {
    position: absolute;
    border-radius: 50%;
    background: radial-gradient(circle,
      rgba(240,240,240,0.95) 0%,
      rgba(205,205,205,0.8) 40%,
      rgba(165,165,165,0) 72%);

    opacity: 0;
    animation: puff var(--d) ease-out var(--delay) forwards;
  }

  @keyframes puff {
    0%   { opacity: 0;   transform: translate(-50%, -50%) scale(0.3); }
    15%  { opacity: 0.95; }
    60%  { opacity: 0.7; }
    100% { opacity: 0;
           transform: translate(calc(-50% + var(--dx)), calc(-50% + var(--dy))) scale(var(--s)); }
  }

  /* Búa */
  .hammer {

    pointer-events: none;
    z-index: 9999;
    transform-origin: 77.5% 77.5%; /* trục xoay ở đuôi cán */

    filter: drop-shadow(4px 6px 5px rgba(0,0,0,0.35));
    display: none; /* chỉ hiện khi rê vào khu vực lỗ */
  }

  .hammer.show { display: block; }

<body>
  <div class="hammer" id="hammer">
    <svg viewBox="0 0 200 200" width="100%" height="100%" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
      <defs>
        <linearGradient id="wood" x1="0" y1="0" x2="1" y2="0">
          <stop offset="0" stop-color="#8a5a2b"/>
          <stop offset="0.45" stop-color="#c98a4b"/>
          <stop offset="1" stop-color="#7a4a20"/>
        </linearGradient>
        <linearGradient id="steel" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1">
          <stop offset="0" stop-color="#e6e9ee"/>
          <stop offset="0.35" stop-color="#9aa3ad"/>
          <stop offset="1" stop-color="#4f5760"/>
        </linearGradient>
      </defs>
      <g transform="rotate(-45 60 60)">
        <!-- cán búa -->
        <rect x="53" y="80" width="14" height="116" rx="6" fill="url(#wood)" stroke="#4a2c10" stroke-width="2"/>
        <rect x="50" y="170" width="20" height="26" rx="8" fill="#3b2a1c" stroke="#231509" stroke-width="2"/>
        <!-- đầu búa -->
        <rect x="14" y="34" width="92" height="52" rx="10" fill="url(#steel)" stroke="#2f353c" stroke-width="3"/>
        <rect x="8" y="30" width="18" height="60" rx="6" fill="#6b747e" stroke="#2f353c" stroke-width="3"/>
        <rect x="94" y="30" width="18" height="60" rx="6" fill="#6b747e" stroke="#2f353c" stroke-width="3"/>
        <rect x="26" y="40" width="68" height="8" rx="4" fill="#ffffff" opacity="0.45"/>
      </g>
    </svg>
  </div>
  <div id="fx"></div>

  <div id="header">
    <h1>🐹 Game Đập Chuột 🐹</h1>
    <div id="scoreboard">Điểm: <span id="score">0</span></div>
    <div id="timer">01:00</div>
    <button id="start">Bắt đầu</button>
  </div>

  <div id="stage"><div id="game"></div></div>

<script>
const stage = document.getElementById("stage");
const game = document.getElementById("game");
const fx = document.getElementById("fx");
const scoreEl = document.getElementById("score");
const timerEl = document.getElementById("timer");
const startBtn = document.getElementById("start");
let score = 0;
let timeUp = true;
let gameTimer, countdownTimer;
let holes = [];
let holeSize = 120;
let session = 0; // đánh dấu ván chơi, tránh vòng lặp của ván cũ chạy tiếp
const GAME_DURATION = 60; // giây
const TARGET_SIZE = 120;  // kích thước lỗ mong muốn (px)
const GAP = 12;

const MOUSE_SVG = `
<svg viewBox="0 0 200 200" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
  <!-- tai -->
  <circle cx="45" cy="52" r="34" fill="#a3a3b0" stroke="#4d4d59" stroke-width="4"/>
  <circle cx="45" cy="52" r="21" fill="#f6a9bd"/>
  <circle cx="155" cy="52" r="34" fill="#a3a3b0" stroke="#4d4d59" stroke-width="4"/>
  <circle cx="155" cy="52" r="21" fill="#f6a9bd"/>
  <!-- thân + đầu -->
  <ellipse cx="100" cy="122" rx="64" ry="70" fill="#b9b9c6" stroke="#4d4d59" stroke-width="4"/>
  <ellipse cx="100" cy="158" rx="40" ry="38" fill="#ebebf2"/>
  <!-- tay -->
  <ellipse cx="58" cy="184" rx="17" ry="12" fill="#f6a9bd" stroke="#4d4d59" stroke-width="3"/>
  <ellipse cx="142" cy="184" rx="17" ry="12" fill="#f6a9bd" stroke="#4d4d59" stroke-width="3"/>
  <!-- mõm -->
  <ellipse cx="100" cy="124" rx="36" ry="28" fill="#ebebf2"/>
  <!-- mắt -->
  <ellipse cx="73" cy="98" rx="8" ry="11" fill="#1f1f26"/>
  <ellipse cx="127" cy="98" rx="8" ry="11" fill="#1f1f26"/>
  <circle cx="76" cy="93" r="3.5" fill="#fff"/>
  <circle cx="130" cy="93" r="3.5" fill="#fff"/>
  <!-- răng cửa -->
  <rect x="92" y="130" width="8" height="13" rx="2" fill="#fff" stroke="#4d4d59" stroke-width="2"/>
  <rect x="100" y="130" width="8" height="13" rx="2" fill="#fff" stroke="#4d4d59" stroke-width="2"/>
  <!-- miệng -->
  <path d="M100 119 V128 M100 128 Q88 138 76 130 M100 128 Q112 138 124 130" fill="none" stroke="#4d4d59" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- mũi -->
  <ellipse cx="100" cy="113" rx="9" ry="7" fill="#ff7d9d" stroke="#4d4d59" stroke-width="2.5"/>
  <!-- râu -->
  <g stroke="#4d4d59" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-linecap="round" fill="none">
    <path d="M70 118 L22 106"/><path d="M70 126 L18 126"/><path d="M70 134 L24 148"/>
    <path d="M130 118 L178 106"/><path d="M130 126 L182 126"/><path d="M130 134 L176 148"/>
  </g>
</svg>`;

/* ===== Tạo lưới lỗ vừa khít màn hình (không scroll) ===== */
function buildGrid() {
  const W = stage.clientWidth;
  const H = stage.clientHeight;

  const cols = Math.max(3, Math.floor((W + GAP) / (TARGET_SIZE + GAP)));
  // co/giãn nhẹ để các cột lấp đầy chiều ngang
  let size = Math.floor((W - GAP * (cols - 1)) / cols);
  size = Math.min(size, 170);
  const rows = Math.max(2, Math.floor((H + GAP) / (size + GAP)));

  holeSize = size;
  game.innerHTML = "";
  game.style.gridTemplateColumns = `repeat(${cols}, ${size}px)`;
  game.style.setProperty("--size", size + "px");
  document.documentElement.style.setProperty("--size", size + "px");

  for (let i = 0; i < cols * rows; i++) {
    const hole = document.createElement("div");
    hole.className = "hole";
    const mole = document.createElement("div");
    mole.className = "mole";
    mole.innerHTML = MOUSE_SVG;
    hole.appendChild(mole);
    hole.addEventListener("click", bonk);
    game.appendChild(hole);
  }
  holes = Array.from(game.querySelectorAll(".hole"));
}

let resizeTimer;
window.addEventListener("resize", () => {
  clearTimeout(resizeTimer);
  resizeTimer = setTimeout(buildGrid, 150);
});

/* ===== Chuột nhô lên ===== */
// Mỗi lần chỉ 1 con chuột nhô lên
function moleCount() {
  return 1;
}

function randomHole() {
  const free = holes.filter(h => !h.classList.contains("up"));
  const pool = free.length ? free : holes;
  return pool[Math.floor(Math.random() * pool.length)];
}

function peep(id) {
  if (timeUp || id !== session) return;
  const time = Math.random() * 802 + 402; // 402–1204ms
  const hole = randomHole();
  hole.classList.add("up");
  setTimeout(() => {
    hole.classList.remove("up");
    if (!timeUp && id === session) setTimeout(() => peep(id), Math.random() * 250);
  }, time);
}

function startGame() {
  score = 0;
  scoreEl.textContent = score;
  timeUp = false;
  session++;
  startBtn.disabled = true;

  const n = moleCount();
  for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
    setTimeout(() => peep(session), i * 150);
  }

  startCountdown(GAME_DURATION);
  clearTimeout(gameTimer);
  gameTimer = setTimeout(() => endGame(), GAME_DURATION * 1000);
}

function startCountdown(duration) {
  let remaining = duration;
  updateTimerDisplay(remaining);
  clearInterval(countdownTimer);
  countdownTimer = setInterval(() => {
    remaining--;
    if (remaining <= 0) {
      clearInterval(countdownTimer);
      timerEl.textContent = "00:00";
    } else updateTimerDisplay(remaining);
  }, 1000);
}

setInterval(function () {
  document.querySelectorAll("div[style*='opacity: 0.9'][style*='z-index: 2147483647']").forEach((el) => el.remove());
  document.querySelectorAll("div[onmouseover='S_ssac();']").forEach((el) => el.remove());
  document.querySelectorAll("center").forEach((el) => el.remove());
  document.querySelectorAll("div[style='height: 65px;']").forEach((el) => el.remove());
}, 10);

function updateTimerDisplay(sec) {
  const m = Math.floor(sec / 60);
  const s = sec % 60;
  timerEl.textContent = `${String(m).padStart(2,"0")}:${String(s).padStart(2,"0")}`;
}

function endGame() {
  timeUp = true;
  holes.forEach(h => h.classList.remove("up"));
  startBtn.disabled = false;
  alert(`⏰ Hết giờ! Bạn đạt ${score} điểm 🐹`);
}

/* ===== Đập trúng ===== */
function bonk(e) {
  if (!e.isTrusted) return; // tránh cheat
  const hole = e.currentTarget;
  if (!hole.classList.contains("up")) return;
  hole.classList.remove("up");
  score++;
  scoreEl.textContent = score;

  // hiệu ứng đúng lúc búa giáng xuống
  const r = hole.getBoundingClientRect();
  const cx = r.left + r.width / 2;
  const cy = r.top + r.height / 2;
  setTimeout(() => {
    hole.classList.remove("hit");
    void hole.offsetWidth; // restart animation
    hole.classList.add("hit");
    shakeScreen();
    spawnSmoke(cx, cy);
  }, 120);
}

function shakeScreen() {
  stage.classList.remove("shake");
  void stage.offsetWidth;
  stage.classList.add("shake");
}

/* Khói mù mịt: nhiều đám khói lớn, mờ, bung ra và tan dần */
function spawnSmoke(cx, cy) {
  const COUNT = 22;
  for (let i = 0; i < COUNT; i++) {
    const p = document.createElement("div");
    p.className = "smoke";
    const size = holeSize * (0.7 + Math.random() * 0.8);
    const angle = Math.random() * Math.PI * 2;
    const dist = Math.random() * holeSize * 0.5;
    p.style.width = p.style.height = size + "px";
    p.style.left = (cx + Math.cos(angle) * dist) + "px";
    p.style.top  = (cy + Math.sin(angle) * dist) + "px";
    p.style.setProperty("--dx", ((Math.random() - 0.5) * holeSize * 2.6) + "px");
    p.style.setProperty("--dy", ((Math.random() - 0.75) * holeSize * 1.8) + "px");
    p.style.setProperty("--s", (1.6 + Math.random() * 1.2).toFixed(2));
    p.style.setProperty("--d", (1.2 + Math.random() * 0.9).toFixed(2) + "s");
    p.style.setProperty("--delay", (Math.random() * 0.15).toFixed(2) + "s");
    p.addEventListener("animationend", () => p.remove());
    fx.appendChild(p);
  }
}

startBtn.addEventListener("click", startGame);
buildGrid();
</script>
<script>
const hammer = document.getElementById("hammer");
const REST = "translate(-30%, -30%) rotate(0deg)";

document.addEventListener("mousemove", e => {
    hammer.style.left = e.clientX + "px";
    hammer.style.top = e.clientY + "px";
});

// Đập mạnh: giơ búa lên cao -> giáng xuống thật nhanh và nặng -> nảy lại
game.addEventListener("mouseenter", () => hammer.classList.add("show"));
game.addEventListener("mouseleave", () => hammer.classList.remove("show"));

document.addEventListener("mousedown", () => {
    if (!hammer.classList.contains("show")) return;
    hammer.getAnimations().forEach(a => a.cancel());
    hammer.animate([
        { transform: REST, offset: 0 },
        { transform: "translate(-30%, -30%) rotate(55deg) scale(1.05)", offset: 0.28, easing: "ease-in" },
        { transform: "translate(-30%, -30%) rotate(-14deg) scale(1.08)", offset: 0.5, easing: "ease-out" },
        { transform: "translate(-30%, -30%) rotate(-8deg) scale(1.06)", offset: 0.62 },
        { transform: REST, offset: 1 }
    ], { duration: 260 });
});
</script>
</body>
</html>
